
---

### How to play

1. Download the `.bps` file below.
2. You need your own **Pokémon FireRed (USA) Rev 1 (v1.1)** ROM (none is provided).
   Its SHA1 should be `dd5945db9b930750cb39d00c84da8571feebf417`; the 1.0 release will not work.
3. Patch it with [Rom Patcher JS](https://www.marcrobledo.com/RomPatcher.js/) (in your browser) or Floating IPS.
4. Play it in an emulator such as mGBA, or on a flash cart.

**Updating from an earlier version:** patch your clean FireRed ROM with this file, and give the new ROM the same name as the old one so your save carries over.
